item.title: 21 Aug — CFTC puts prediction on the record
item.description:
What changed for us
- US — CFTC sat down on August 20 for the inaugural Innovation Advisory Committee (IAC) meeting; “prediction markets & event contracts” were named focus areas on the published agenda and event page. This is the first scheduled public forum under the new Chair to scope how incentives, listings, and surveillance should work. Why it matters: even without rule text, staff takeawa…
